issues.description: Animal access modifiers conflict between specification/UML and the solution: the UML and task text require Animal(String), getName(), and setName(String) to be protected (UML shows '#' and the note explicitly says protected getter/setter), but the solution implements all three as public. This can mislead students about required encapsulation and may break tests that enforce UML visibility.
issues.suggestedFix: Align spec and implementation: either change Animal's constructor/getter/setter in the solution to protected (matching UML and the note), or update the UML/task text to explicitly require public access if that is the intended design.

issues.description: Farm.singFarmSongVerse signature mismatch between template and specification: the template defines `private void singFarmSongVerse(/*Animal animal*/)` (no parameter), while the UML/spec and solution require `private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)`. This forces students to modify the method signature before they can implement the required verse logic for each Animal.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template to `private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)` (and ensure Animal is available/imported) so the starter code matches the UML/spec and intended implementation.
